Cookie Policy

Cookie Policy

How cookies are used on the American Clothing Restoration website.

Essential Cookies

Essential cookies support basic website functions, such as remembering your cookie preference. These cookies are necessary for the site to work properly.

Non-Essential Cookies

Non-essential cookies may be used to understand general website activity and improve the visitor experience. You can accept or reject non-essential cookies using the cookie banner or Cookie Settings link in the footer.

Managing Cookies

You can reopen cookie preferences at any time by selecting Cookie Settings in the footer. You may also manage or delete cookies through your browser settings.
